findings.claim: The tooltip indicator border no longer uses the per-series chart color, violating the visual-parity requirement.
findings.evidence: The hunk changes `"shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-[--color-border] bg-[--color-bg]"` to `"shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-border bg-(--color-bg)"`, replacing the dynamic `--color-border` value with the global theme border color; acceptance criteria state visual output should be unchanged except chat width/wrapping.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the Tailwind v4 CSS-variable shorthand for the existing variable, e.g. `border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-bg)`, instead of `border-border`.

findings.claim: The dialog close-button hover selector was transformed into a selector that no longer represents 'button hover changes child svg color'.
findings.evidence: The hunk changes `[&>button]:hover:[&_svg]:text-destructive` to `[&_svg]:hover:[&>button]:text-destructive`; the original selector was scoped to the close button hover, while the new selector reverses the relationship and targets through `_svg` first.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a v4-compatible selector that preserves the original relationship, such as `[&>button:hover_svg]:text-destructive`, or verify and replace with the correct Tailwind v4 stacked variant form.

findings.claim: The change records remaining ESLint warnings despite the project warning constraint requiring ESLint to be clean.
findings.evidence: Constraint `no-lint-warnings` says `ESLint clean`; verification records `npm run lint`: `0 errors, 6 warnings`.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve the six ESLint warnings or record an explicit accepted exception in the applicable process if warning constraints are allowed to remain.
